_documentation: Per-instrument live-trading permission. All instruments default to false. A true value here is required, but not sufficient, for a live order. LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=true in the environment AND the instrument-specific flag being true AND the environment being testnet are all required. Production requires a fourth separate unlock.

BTC/USDT.note: Paper only. Flip to true and set LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=true to allow Binance Spot Testnet orders.

EUR/USD.note: Paper only. MT5 adapter is not yet implemented.

GBP/USD.note: Paper only. MT5 adapter is not yet implemented.

global.note: Setting this to true is a separate act from LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED. Production orders require both.
